rendered: The paper does not give a cost per kWh for the NFA 811[1] pouch cell. That cell is discussed only for its electrochemical performance in a full pouch cell (see Fig. 7[2] for its formation and cycling data). The only cost-per-kWh figure in the paper is the Department of Energy cell cost target of $80/kWh[3]. The paper also says, for LIB cells in general rather than for the NFA cell, that current manufacturing costs are about double this figure[4]. So the $80/kWh value is a target, not a cost for the NFA cell.
